label: scrub 20 steps, 50ms apart (held key)
eval: (async () => { const vs = __plexora.viewState; const fade = __plexora.planeMotion.fade; const log = []; const cap = fade.capture.bind(fade); const t0 = performance.now(); fade.capture = () => { const r = cap(); log.push([Math.round(performance.now()-t0), vs.appliedSpec() + '>' + vs.spec(), fade.duration()]); return r; }; const start = vs.get().z; for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { vs.step(1); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50)); } const inputEnd = Math.round(performance.now()-t0); await vs.settled(); fade.capture = cap; return {from: start, to: vs.get().z, inputEnd, settled: Math.round(performance.now()-t0), swaps: log.length, log}; })()
